findings.governingReading: Shirou judges Sakura’s physical condition many times worse than his.
findings.explanation: The English drops the explicit magnitude that drives his refusal to rest.

findings.evidenceJa: 我ながら芸のない言葉を返す
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes his reply as painfully unimaginative and repetitive.
findings.explanation: The English changes lack of originality into lack of intelligence.

findings.highlight: The instant she sees me relax
findings.evidenceJa: 安堵を込めて口にした言葉
findings.governingReading: Shirou speaks the third greeting with relief in his words.
findings.explanation: The English invents Sakura observing a moment of relaxation and deletes the narration of how he speaks.

findings.highlight: I start eating to hide it
findings.evidenceJa: 照れ隠しにメシをかっ込んだ
findings.governingReading: Already at breakfast, Shirou shovels food into his mouth to hide his embarrassment.
findings.explanation: The English loses the hurried force and incorrectly presents the action as beginning to eat.
